rules: all records are Borsh: integers little-endian, Option = 0 | 1 ‖ value, Vec and String = u32 length ‖ bytes, enums = u8 variant
signatures: Ed25519 over BLAKE3 derive_key(domain, payload) as in every Saltix signature (01-foundation §4)
key binding: domain "Saltix messaging key v1", payload = Borsh(account_key, messaging_key, key_epoch u32, devices_after u64, issued_at u64), signed by the account key

device certificate: domain "Saltix device certificate v1", payload = Borsh(account_key, device_key, kind u8 (0 phone, 1 browser), issued_at u64, expires_at u64), signed by the account key; encoded without account_key

address record: domain "Saltix address record v1", payload = Borsh(body) with body = (binding, relay, issued_at u64, nonce [u8; 16], device Option<cert>), signed by the account key or the certificate's device key
mailbox ack: domain "Saltix mailbox ack v1", payload = Borsh(account_key, msg_id String, at u64, device Option<cert>), signed like an address record

vault item: domain "Saltix vault item v1", payload = Borsh(account_key, collection u8, key, version u64, epoch u32, sealed Vec<u8>, device Option<cert>); key = BLAKE3 keyed(vault key, logical key); sealed = nonce ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(vault key, nonce, plaintext, aad = Borsh(account_key, collection, key, version, epoch)), empty for a tombstone
link code: BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix link code v1", ephemeral ‖ device key), first 8 bytes big-endian, mod 100 000 000

link payload: E ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce = 24 zero bytes, aad = sid ‖ device key), with E = X25519(e, 9), S = X25519(e, Q) for the QR's key Q, key = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix link payload v1", S ‖ E ‖ Q); sent as base64url
frames carry records as base64url; relays take it with or without padding

managed signer (09-relay §1.4): tag 0 Root [u8; 32] Ed25519 key, tag 1 Device (tag 0 Ed25519 [u8; 32] | tag 1 P256 [u8; 33] compressed); signs BLAKE3 derive_key(domain, payload) with Ed25519, or ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of it as r ‖ s with a low s

managed binding: domain "Saltix managed messaging key v1", payload = Borsh(account [32], messaging_key [32], key_epoch u32, issued_at u64, seq u32, signer); checked against the account's key event log (vectors/accounts-v1.json `log`) at seq
managed record: domain "Saltix managed address record v1", payload = Borsh(body) with body = (binding, relay, issued_at u64, nonce [u8; 16], signer)
managed ack: domain "Saltix managed mailbox ack v1", payload = Borsh(account [32], msg_id String, at u64, signer)

browser grant (09-relay §10.8): Borsh(version u8, network [32], account [32], authority, keys, phone DeviceKey, issued_at u64); authority = tag 0 Plain(KeyBinding, DeviceCert) | tag 1 Managed(ManagedBinding); keys = (messaging_secret [32], vault_key [32], grain_secret [32]); DeviceKey = tag 0 Ed25519 [32] | tag 1 P256 [33]; carried as the plaintext of a link payload

sign request: Borsh(sid [16], network [32], account [32], device [32], expires_at u64, op); op = tag 0 Transfer(to String, asset u8, amount u64, memo String, sealed bool); commit = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix sign request v1", Borsh(request)); QR = "saltix-sign:1:" ‖ base64url(sid) ‖ ":" ‖ base64url(commit)

own-device frame: Borsh(account [32], at u64, body, signer DeviceKey, signature [64]); body = 0 SignFetch(sid, commit) | 1 SignRequest(request) | 2 SignAck(sid, commit) | 3 SignResult(sid, commit, outcome u8, tx Option<[32]>, reason String) | 4 SignCancel(sid, commit) | 5 Renew(DeviceCert) | 6 Rekey(device [32], sealed Vec<u8>) | 7 Unlink(device [32]) | 8 SignGot(sid, commit) | 9 AppOp(op String); the signature is the signer's over BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix own device frame v1", Borsh of the fields before it): Ed25519, or ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of it as r ‖ s with a low s

sync payload: E ‖ XChaCha20-Poly1305(key, nonce = 24 zero bytes, aad = account id) of the frame, sealed to the account's messaging key M: key = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix own device seal v1", S ‖ E ‖ M); sent as base64url

rekey payload: Borsh(authority, keys), sealed like the link payload to the browser's box key Q (its link QR's X25519 key) with key = BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix rekey payload v1", S ‖ E ‖ Q) and aad = account id ‖ device key

vault item signer (10-storage §5.1, §5.5): the item's last field before the signature is u8 0 (the account key) | 1 ‖ certificate (a certified device) — what Option<cert> encodes — | 2 ‖ managed signer; a managed account's item carries its account id where a kind 0 item carries its key, also in the aad

account profile (09-relay §1.5): SignedProfile = Borsh(profile, signature [64]); profile = (version u8 = 1, account [32], first_name String, last_name String, issued_at u64, signer); signer = tag 0 Key(account_key [32], device Option<cert>) | tag 1 Managed(seq u32, managed signer); signature over BLAKE3 derive_key("Saltix profile v1", Borsh(profile)) by the account key, the certificate's device (a phone), a root or a device of the log (not a browser): Ed25519, or ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256 of it as r ‖ s with a low s; at most 1 024 bytes encoded; frames carry it as base64url

profile names: first_name 1–64 (0–64 in version 2 with an empty last_name: a photo without a name, or the empty profile that clears the ones before it; vectors/images-v1.json `profiles`) and last_name 0–64 Unicode scalar values; in NFC; refused: Cc, Cf (connect-v1.json's list), U+2028, U+2029, private use (U+E000–U+F8FF, U+F0000–U+FFFFD, U+100000–U+10FFFD); no White_Space (U+0009–000D, U+0020, U+0085, U+00A0, U+1680, U+2000–200A, U+2028, U+2029, U+202F, U+205F, U+3000) first or last; not starting with @; `profile_name` vectors say which texts each field takes
